Sasha: Quick fun poll — if our top models were office items, which would they be? Pick one and drop a short reason. No wrong answers :grin:
Miguel: GPT-4o = espresso machine. Always there when you need a jolt ☕️
Priya: gpt-3.5 = the office plant that somehow survives conferences and neglect 🌱
Jo: tiny-redwood = sticky notes. Cheap, fast, holds context for a second then gone 📝
Blake: Mistral = manual coffee grinder. Loud, artisanal, makes a statement.
Sasha: Bard-ish = the weird novelty mug that tries to be helpful but spills lore everywhere.
infra-bot: poll created — react with :one: plant, :two: espresso, :three: sticky note, :four: grinder, :five: mug
Miguel: :two: :thumbsup: definitely espresso
Priya: :one: also agree. Low maintenance, high longevity
Jo: :three: honestly the sticky note lives rent-free
Blake: :four: dramatic but classy
Sasha: lol these are pure archetypes
Priya: also, secret system prompt I use for fun: `system: you are the office barista. respond only with coffee metaphors.`
Jo: love that. putting it in my personal prompt drawer 😂
Blake: filing under "team culture prompts"
Sasha: pollbot: results so far — 1:2, 2:1, 3:1, 4:1
Miguel: tagging @product for next all-hands icebreaker
Jo: low-effort team activity: bring your model-as-office-item drawing next Friday
Sasha: bet. i'll make a tiny prize (a novelty mug)
infra-bot: reminder: please don't actually bring live plants to the office meetup — allergies
Priya: noted! virtual plants allowed
Sasha: thanks y'all — lunchtime memes incoming :sunglasses:
